svg.text: The builder's monitoring stack for the post-CoT era
Five layers - keep building them even while the scratchpad is still readable

g.text: 1. Keep reading the chain of thought - while it exists
Log and review reasoning summaries on your hardest agent tasks
Caveat: AISI found summaries omitted up to 80% of steps on long cyber trajectories - treat as a lossy trace, not ground truth
Track whether your agent performs differently when it can tell it is being tested
System card: evaluation awareness appeared in 9.6% of Astra trajectories vs 2.8% for GPT-5.6 Sol - a 3.4x jump
3. Build behavioral canaries, not just text audits
Outcomes, tool-call sequences, diff reviews, spend anomalies - things that survive opaque reasoning
If the model can think without writing, only its actions are guaranteed observable
4. Demand interpretability and audits from vendors
UK AISI got real numbers into the system card; independent evals worked this time
One insider quote ("depth within 2x of GPT-4") moved the entire debate - that is not an audit regime, it is vibes
5. Match model depth to blast radius
Long-horizon, low-supervision loops (hours-long, prod-touching) deserve the most conservative models
30.9 min per step = more autonomous work between your checkpoints

svg.text: Framework: author's synthesis of the GPT-6 system card, UK AISI findings, and the September 2026 monitorability debate
